title: Understanding the Scatterplot
text: Look at the scatterplot of the first two principal components. Notice how the points are grouped into three distinct clusters. These clusters represent different types of visitors based on their exhibit preferences.

title: Analyzing the First Row of $$V^T$$
text: The first row of $$V^T$$ shows the contribution of each exhibit to the first principal component. Look at which exhibits have the highest positive or negative values.

title: Analyzing the Second Row of $$V^T$$
text: The second row of $$V^T$$ shows the contribution of each exhibit to the second principal component. Identify which exhibits have the highest positive or negative values here.

hintAnswer: These visitors spend a lot of time at the mammal exhibits (cheetah, tiger, and lion).
title: Characteristics of the Bottom-Left Group
text: Based on the plots of $$V^T$$, which exhibits do the visitors in the bottom-left group spend the most time at?
choices: These visitors spend a lot of time at the mammal exhibits (cheetah, tiger, and lion).
These visitors spend a lot of time at the activities (train and playground).
These visitors spend a lot of time at the reptile exhibits (turtle, iguana, and alligator).
These visitors spend very little time at any of the $$8$$ exhibits.
These visitors spend about the same amount of time at every exhibit.
